_comment: Canonical Common Core Ontologies (CCO v2.1) module manifest — the COMPLETE set of 11 domain modules (per develop catalog-v001.xml; bfo-core is the BFO import, not a CCO module). This is the completeness anchor: coverage is measured against all 11, so partial coverage reads honestly (e.g. 9/11). Grounding/import of the module TTLs is Aegir's job; this file lets the applied side (fixtures, coverage eval) reference the complete set. reachable_via: which annotation shape surfaces the module — CTA (column type), CPA (column property/relation), EAV (entity-attribute-value tables relocate units+relations into column content). See docs/src/architecture/cco-coverage.md.

modules.label: Information Entity
modules.note: Atelier's ICE classification root (cco:ont00000958); Designative/Descriptive/Prescriptive trichotomy

modules.label: Units of Measure
modules.note: Units are value-level in wide tables; an EAV unit column makes them a column type

modules.label: Extended Relation
modules.note: Relations are column properties; EAV attribute column or SOTAB CPA surfaces them
